name: Aspect Shrine Token
community_notes: Once per battle, change one Hit or Wound roll to an unmodified 6. Modeled as 1 guaranteed crit hit per activation to capture GW's pricing signal. Actual mechanic is once-per-game.

name: Point‐blank Devastation
community_notes: [APPROX] The 'within half range' gate is approximated as within-weapon-range (opponent-unit-within-range on the heavy wraithcannon / suncannon); the re-roll of the random Attacks characteristic uses subset all-failures per the codebase re-roll convention. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Cluster caltrops
community_notes: [APPROX] The rule grants one re-roll per model equipped with cluster caltrops; the per-model re-roll count is not expressible, so it is modeled as a re-roll of the Eviscerating Fly-by wound dice (subset all-failures per the codebase re-roll convention). Full rule in raw-text store.

modifier.restriction: can only be selected as ranged target if attacker within 18"

name: Indomitable Strength of Will
community_notes: [APPROX] The specific trigger (spending a Battle Focus token to enable an Agile Manoeuvre) is not expressible; encodes the is-attached gate plus the D6 3+ that returns 1 Battle Focus token. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Hallucinogen Grenades
community_notes: [APPROX] Used at the start of your opponent's Shooting phase; the selection is MANDATORY (select exactly one eligible unit), not the optional 'up to one' the select-units selector can express, and the selected unit must be visible to and within 36" of this unit. Neither the mandatory exactly-one count nor the visibility/36" range gate is expressible in the selector (it carries only max_count, plus keywords/owner). The selected AELDARI INFANTRY unit gains the Stealth ability until the end of that phase. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Shadow Field
community_notes: fragile invuln: lost on a failed save (engine reads the 4+; the breaking mechanic is not modelled)

name: Spirit Mark
community_notes: Once per turn, in your Movement phase, when this model starts or ends a move. The benefit applies only to one selected friendly WRAITH CONSTRUCT unit within 6" of this model (the shape models it as all attackers of the marked unit). Lasts until the start of your next Movement phase.

name: Battle Focus
community_notes: Aeldari army rule, active while the Army Faction is ASURYANI: at the start of each battle round the army gains Battle Focus tokens scaled by the current battle size (Incursion 2, Strike Force 4, Onslaught 6). Spending a token lets one eligible unit perform an Agile Manoeuvre this phase (Swift as the Wind, Flitting Shadows, Star Engines, Sudden Strike, Opportunity Seized, or Fade Back); a unit performs at most one Agile Manoeuvre per phase, and each named manoeuvre triggers at most once per phase, except Swift as the Wind, which different units may each perform. Unspent tokens are lost at the end of the battle round. Fade Back binds the enemy shooter and requires the selected friendly unit to have been hit by an attack from that shooter during its just-finished shooting sequence. Full rule in the raw-text store.

name: Acrobatic Onslaught
community_notes: [APPROX] HARLEQUINS models may move through enemy models when making a Charge move; modeled as passthrough of non-titanic models (the prose says enemy models generally). Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Exit the Stage
community_notes: Used at the end of your opponent's Fight phase on one friendly unengaged HARLEQUINS unit; that unit is placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Deceptive Feint
community_notes: Reactive counter-move. Trigger gates on an enemy ending a move within 8 inches of the bearer, in the opponent's Movement phase; the bearer (a HARLEQUINS INFANTRY unit, curated via applies_to) then makes a Normal move of D3+3 inches unless it is within Engagement Range. Provisional 11e; see #21.

name: Ride the Wind
community_notes: [APPROX] the number of units returned to Strategic Reserves at the end of your opponent's turn is capped by battle size, and units within Engagement Range of enemy units cannot be selected

name: Shepherds of the Dead
community_notes: [APPROX] A Vengeful Dead token is placed automatically on whichever enemy destroys an ASURYANI PSYKER (not player-selected), and the +1 Hit / +1 Wound bonus applies only to WRAITH CONSTRUCT attacks against that marked unit (attacker-keyword restriction not modeled). The Spirit Guides half grants Battle Focus to WRAITHBLADES/WRAITHGUARD/WRAITHLORD units within 12" of an ASURYANI PSYKER (the 12" range and target-keyword restriction are not modeled). Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Strength from Death
community_notes: [APPROX] Encodes the three Ynnari rules: Lethal Intent (end of opponent's Shooting phase, if a YNNARI unit was destroyed that phase, a YNNARI INFANTRY/MOUNTED unit within 6" of it makes a Normal move of D6+1" — the within-6" and INFANTRY/MOUNTED restrictions are not modeled); Lethal Surge (once per turn, a YNNARI unit performing the Fade Back Agile Manoeuvre may make a D6+1" move that can end within Engagement Range — the Fade Back trigger, once-per-turn limit and engagement-range allowance are not modeled); Lethal Reprisal (start of the Fight phase, a below-Starting-Strength YNNARI unit excluding TITANIC gains Fights First). Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Relentless Raiders
community_notes: [APPROX] The mortal-wound half triggers when an enemy ends a Normal/Advance/Fall Back/Charge move within range of an objective you control (D6, 2+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds); the enemy is modeled as enemy-within-aura and the move-ended trigger is not expressible as a condition. The Void Thieves half grants ANHRATHE units sticky objective control, modeled via objective-control-modifier sticky. Full rule in raw-text store.

name: Yriel’s Own
community_notes: AELDARI units may declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced; ANHRATHE, RANGERS and SHROUD RUNNERS units may additionally re-roll the Advance roll.
